punchline: They changed the king, and wrote down what the next king could not do.
thirty_sec: After William of Orange landed in 1688 and James II fled, Parliament made William and Mary joint monarchs in 1689 and set limits on taxes and laws. Acemoglu and Robinson see power moving into more hands.
question: Which limits will you agree in writing the next time you give someone authority?
key_contrast: The lasting change was the limits on the crown, not the new crown.
